nodes.svg_description: Playful, distressed emblem composed of five hand-drawn, textured shapes stacked in a loose 2x3 grid, each with speckled/grunge cutouts revealing the blue background (#39476a). Top-left: a cream eye icon (#f2e6d0) with an oval pupil and 10 short lash ticks radiating around the top and bottom. Top-right: a tall rounded pink arch block (#f39fb2) resembling an inverted U. Center-left: a vertical wavy blue blob (#4aa0bf) shaped like a squishy letter M with three humps. Center-right: a mustard-yellow rounded square (#efc05a) containing a single-line spiral resembling a stylized lowercase e, centered within the square. Bottom-left: a short horizontal pink bar (#f39fb2) aligned under the blue blob. All shapes have uneven edges and a vintage, stamped texture with random darker flecks.
